# Step - to_upper

`to_upper` · `toUpper` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts each string to upper case.

## Forms

```text
to_upper()
to_upper(arg1: Scope)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).values("name").to_upper().next()   // MARKO
```
